summary: REDACTED: this run's portfolio summary names a project that is private by rule. Full detail is in the constellation report; withheld from the public copy.

topActions.label: Upload the personal-skills plugin from X:\PortfolioOps\plugin\personal-skills-0.7.0.zip in the desktop application, so the snapshot every headless session loads stops running a fourteen-skill-stale copy whose git recovery skill still tells a session to delete a lock by hand.
Run the project-pages updater so every homepage card re-stamps from its project's current status file, then find why the per-release stamping fell behind on four of four live projects at once.
Run the Here Be Hordes release, or commit the nine touched files with an explicit path list, so the five verified fixes stop existing only in one working tree.

Cancel only the subscription the refunded charge names in the Chains webhook, instead of walking every non-terminal subscription on that customer; a refund on one charge currently cancels every subscription the customer holds.

Drop the Gnosis questions minted past the three-a-day ceiling from the vault and confirm the build exits zero, so the release script can get past its own build step again; never raise the cap to clear it.
Rewrite the three public files that name the private manuscript, its sale intent and its local source path so they describe the gate mechanism without naming the work.

Fix both faults in the Chains migrations before they are next pasted into the database editor: the soft-delete column has no matching update policy, so unstarring silently stops working, and the timestamp column takes its default before its own backfill runs, so the backfill matches nothing.
Make the three Gnosis key-value writers fail closed on a failed read, instead of writing a near-empty map over everyone's data.
Delete the five stray text fragments inside the Chains page head, which close the head early and render as visible words ahead of the real page header on the live site.
Recast the shipped Chains strings that carry a long dash, starting with the sign-in modal, the round view and the profile view, and rewrite the sign-in line out of collective voice.
